dialogue_texts: Seriously, first Koakuma throws a tantrum about the Grieg twins...
And now I find myself in the Kozankyo Cemetery...
This festival could be seconds away from being completely ruined.
Ruined? Oh, I'd say the festivities are only just beginning.
The vampires love a good performance, after all.
Welcome to the quietest corner of Kozankyo, Your Honor.
I am Doromi Akatsuki - the most prim dhampir you'll ever meet.
A dhampir? Great, another half-baked vampire messing around.
Let me guess - you're affiliated with the Order too, right?
Affiliated? Let's just say our interests... align.
And I simply require a lively venue to test the boundaries of this parallel.
I don't care. You're disturbing the peace, and you're standing between me and my day off.
But out here, where the veil between worlds is as thin as my inheritance...
Your charms won't save you from the twilight.
Bold words for someone about to get thrown in prison. I'll purify this whole cemetery if I have to!
Fascinating. Let us see if your light can pierce the eternal shroud!
